<ns0:Code>P08</ns0:Code><ns0:Name>Missing annotations</ns0:Name>
<ns0:Description>This pitfall consists in creating an ontology element and failing to provide human readable annotations attached to it. Consequently, ontology elements lack annotation properties that label them (e.g. rdfs:label, lemon:LexicalEntry, skos:prefLabel or skos:altLabel) or that define them (e.g. rdfs:comment or dc:description).
